newsitem.title: USA: Prime Retail shares priced in secondary.
newsitem.headline: Prime Retail shares priced in secondary.

text.p: Prime Retail Inc said Friday that its secondary offering of 2,080,000 shares of its common stock and 175,800 shares of its 8.5 percent series B cumulative participating convertible preferred stock were priced for sale at at $12.50 a share and $22.75 a share.
The net proceeds from the offering will be used to repay certain outstanding corporate indebtedness, to fund the construction of certain development projects and for general corporate purposes.

Friedman, Billings, Ramsey & Co. INc., Morgan Keegan & company Inc., and Stifel, Nicolaus & Co Inc were the underwriters. The company has granted the underwriters an option, exercisable for 30 days, to purchase up to 312,000 additional shares of common stock to cover over-allotments.
